subject: removed XXH64's switch finalizer (#521)

units.name: Replaces switch-based XXH64 tail handling.
units.evidence: All 32 AArch64 and i386 fixed-length one-shot targets prove bidirectionally, as do 32 x86 short and 15 longer targets. Streaming matrix has one timeout and four non-returning targets.

units.name: Raw XXH64_finalize, all 32 tail residues and both alignments, old switch and rerolled modes on x86-64
units.precondition: valid bytes for each tail and alignment requirement; default memory access mode
units.evidence: finalizer-proof-audit.json: 128 bidirectional Alive2 checks, no remaining IR loops

notes: The raw finalizer is proved under x86-64 Clang 20/default memory access; source uses only len & 31, so the 32 residue cases cover every size_t length for each tested alignment and old control-flow mode. Whole public APIs, other architectures and memory access configurations remain inconclusive.
